why: The learner wrote scale as an arrow function in an earlier step; F2 renamed it to scaleRecipe in recipe-utils.js (const scaleRecipe = (recipe, factor) => ..., exported) and in scale.js (require and call), and node scale.js prints the six doubled lines. A function named scaleRecipe is defined in one file and called from scale.js.

step.title: Rename scale to scaleRecipe
step.instructions: In recipe-utils.js, put the cursor on scale, press F2, type scaleRecipe and press Enter. VS Code renames the function and every use of it, in scale.js too. Then run node scale.js.
hints: F2 renames a symbol in every file that uses it; Find and Replace only changes the open file.
common_mistakes: Renaming the function by hand and leaving the old name in scale.js's require line.
